**Finding submitted: deviation (Section 2.1, ¶p0012).**

Section 2.1 binds us to a three-year, USD 2,000,000-per-year take-or-pay commitment "without reduction or termination rights" — squarely in the rule's walk-away territory and well short of the fallback (12-month commitment, reducible on 30 days' notice, true-up not penalty). It also contradicts Section 12.3, where Vendor acknowledges we made no minimum-volume commitment, and undercuts the Section 9 termination rights.

Redline (validated, preferred position, aligned to the Bluewater precedent): replace the commitment with "Customer has no minimum purchase commitment. Customer will pay only for Services used or ordered during the applicable term," with a 12-month reducible/true-up commitment offered as fallback in the comment.
